foto-01.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one individual N1 visual vocabulary stimulus for Catalan POR (fear). Create ONE square synthetic studio photograph of a real human face, a 12-year-old girl with light olive skin and brown bobbed hair wearing a plain teal T-shirt. Head, neck and upper shoulders visible, face very large and dominant. Her facial expression clearly communicates fearful apprehension: inner eyebrows raised and drawn together, eyes wide, tense lower eyelids, lips slightly parted and stretched, gaze cautiously toward the side. Natural believable human facial anatomy, school-appropriate, no actual threatening event. Pure white seamless background and generous margin above intact head and beside shoulders. Full head and ears visible. No scene, no threat objects, no other person, no emoji, no symbolic drawings, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Crisp evenly lit documentary portrait, natural proportions, not caricature. This is fear rather than neutral surprise: visible brow tension and apprehension.

review.scope: Revisió visual de producció pel mateix assistent que ha preparat els prompts; no és una lectura cega ni una validació amb participants.

alt.ca: Cara amb les celles alçades i juntes, els ulls oberts i els llavis tensos.
alt.es: Rostro con las cejas elevadas y juntas, los ojos abiertos y los labios tensos.

foto-02.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: POR. ONE synthetic studio PHOTOGRAPH of a different exemplar/person. Realistic skin, natural proportions, detailed photographic rendering, soft neutral lighting. No illustration. Subject: a Black man in his 30s with short tightly curled hair in a mustard shirt. Visual content: Fearful apprehension: inner brows raised and drawn together, wide eyes with tense lower lids, lips slightly parted and stretched; cautious sidelong gaze. Fear is clear in the human FACE alone. Do not depict a threat or horror.  Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Full head, ears, neck and upper shoulders, scalp entirely inside frame and white margin above it; natural portrait crop at upper chest. Human face large, directly readable. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.
